Frontend: /course-room AlistairModeSelector renders, 3 mode buttons clickable, picking 'focus' reveals alistair-mode-frame with first_message preview. /body-room PostSessionMoodReflect full flow works (textarea → submit → Claude returns aurin_line within 20s, with 'Your words have been forgotten' privacy reassurance). /clarity-release: after passing the 4-truths gate + companion orb + enter, BOTH grace-mood-reflect and grace-mode-section appear. Kids Activities visual polish confirmed: little-dreamers=11, explorers=25, dreamweavers=19 cards across 5 module tabs; card titles use 'Caveat, Fraunces, serif' handwriting; UNAUTHED explorers shows 14/25 cards locked with padlock icons; AUTHED premium shows 0 locks (correct). All 7 smoke routes return 200, ZERO page errors observed in 4 separate runs.

issues: Computed background on cards reads as pure white→white linear-gradient (rgb(255,255,255)→rgb(255,255,255)). The visual palette accent comes from the small top-left icon bubble and the locked padlock, not from a card-level gradient as described in spec ('white→palette gradient + top sheen'). If Anna intended a tinted gradient on the card body itself (cream/peach/sage/mint by age), the palette tint is NOT bleeding into the card background — only into the surrounding page chrome. This is cosmetic only; the page is still beautiful and palette-distinct at the page level.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py §VOICE-MOOD-NLP: _extract_mood_from_text imports emergentintegrations INSIDE the function on every call — moving the import to module top-level would shave ~30-80ms per call. Non-blocking.
server.py: voice_mood_recent caps days at 60 but does not validate negative input (days=-1 silently becomes 1 via max(1,...)) — fine but worth a 400 for clarity.
AlistairModeSelector: server stores `alistair_mode_set_at` as ISO string while other recent timestamps elsewhere use datetime objects. Minor inconsistency for future analytics queries.

KidsActivities cards visually look like pure white tiles; the spec text 'white→palette gradient + top sheen' suggests the body should subtly tint by age (peach/sage/mint). Currently only icon bubbles + tab pills carry the palette accent. Anna may want to verify this matches her intent before shipping — it could be intentional (clean cream-on-cream) or a missed gradient binding.
